title.en: Parable of the Workers in the Vineyard (1)

description.en: All laborers receive the same wage regardless of hours worked — God's grace is not earned.
description.zh-Hans: 无论做工多久,工人都得同样的工价——神的恩典不是赚来的。
description.zh-Hant: 無論做工多久,工人都得同樣的工價——神的恩典不是賺來的。

description.en: Tenants kill the owner's servants and son — Jesus' indictment of Israel's leaders rejecting God's prophets and Son.
description.zh-Hans: 园户杀害主人的仆人和儿子——耶稣指责以色列领袖拒绝神的先知与圣子。
description.zh-Hant: 園戶殺害主人的僕人和兒子——耶穌指責以色列領袖拒絕神的先知與聖子。

description.zh-Hans: 受邀者不来赴王的婚筵,街上的陌生人坐满席——被召的多,选上的少。

description.zh-Hans: 仆人受托银子,投资的得赏赐,埋藏的受责备。
description.zh-Hant: 僕人受託銀子,投資的得賞賜,埋藏的受責備。

description.en: At the Final Judgment, the King separates sheep from goats — feeding the hungry and visiting the prisoner counted as done to Him.
description.zh-Hans: 末日审判,君王将绵羊与山羊分开——给饥者食、探监者,如同做在主身上。

description.zh-Hans: 聪明人把房子盖在磐石上,愚拙人盖在沙土上——惟有听道并行道的能经得起风雨。
description.zh-Hant: 聰明人把房子蓋在磐石上,愚拙人蓋在沙土上——惟有聽道並行道的能經得起風雨。

description.zh-Hant: 一個兒子說不去卻去了,另一個說去了卻沒去——真正順服勝過空口應許。

description.zh-Hant: 半夜求餅的朋友——切切恆切的禱告必蒙應允。

description.zh-Hans: 寡妇不住地央求,使不义的官也为她伸冤——神的选民日夜呼求,祂岂不更快为他们伸冤?

description.zh-Hant: 一點麵酵能使全團發起來——天國如同麵酵,默默滲透。

description.zh-Hans: 客商变卖一切去买那颗重价珠子——天国值得我们付上一切代价。
description.zh-Hant: 客商變賣一切去買那顆重價珠子——天國值得我們付上一切代價。

description.en: Jesus declares 'I am the bread of life' — eternal life through eating His flesh and drinking His blood.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣宣告「我就是生命的粮」——吃祂的肉、喝祂的血得永生。

description.en: 'I am the true vine, you are the branches' — abide in Christ to bear fruit; apart from Him we can do nothing.
description.zh-Hans: 「我是真葡萄树,你们是枝子」——常在主里才能结果子;离了祂,我们就不能做什么。
description.zh-Hant: 「我是真葡萄樹,你們是枝子」——常在主裏才能結果子;離了祂,我們就不能做什麼。

description.en: Jesus' prophecy of the temple's destruction and His return — signs of the end, the call to watchfulness.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣预言圣殿被毁与祂的再来——末后的预兆与警醒的呼召。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌預言聖殿被毀與祂的再來——末後的預兆與警醒的呼召。

description.en: Jesus' farewell words to His disciples on the night He was betrayed — the promise of the Holy Spirit, the new commandment.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣被卖那夜对门徒的临别讲论——应许圣灵,新命令。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌被賣那夜對門徒的臨別講論——應許聖靈,新命令。

description.en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength — and your neighbor as yourself.
description.zh-Hans: 尽心尽性尽意尽力爱主你的神,又要爱人如己。
description.zh-Hant: 盡心盡性盡意盡力愛主你的神,又要愛人如己。

title.en: The Boy Jesus at the Temple (1)

description.en: Twelve-year-old Jesus is found three days later in the Temple, sitting among the teachers, hearing and asking questions.
description.zh-Hans: 十二岁的耶稣三天后被找到,在圣殿里坐在教师中间,听讲和发问。
description.zh-Hant: 十二歲的耶穌三天後被找到,在聖殿裡坐在教師中間,聽講和發問。

description.en: Jesus walks on the storm-tossed sea to His disciples; Peter steps out, sinks in doubt, and is caught by the Lord's hand.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣在风浪的海面上走向门徒;彼得下船,因疑惑下沉,被主的手扶住。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌在風浪的海面上走向門徒;彼得下船,因疑惑下沉,被主的手扶住。

description.en: Jesus weeps at the tomb, then cries 'Lazarus, come forth!' — four days dead, Lazarus walks out alive.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣在坟前哭了,然后呼喊「拉撒路,出来!」——已死四天的拉撒路活着走出。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌在墳前哭了,然後呼喊「拉撒路,出來!」——已死四天的拉撒路活著走出。

description.en: At the Last Supper Jesus girds a towel, fills a basin, and washes His disciples' feet — Lord serving as servant.
description.zh-Hans: 在最后晚餐时,耶稣束上手巾,倒水入盆,为门徒洗脚——主作仆人之事。
description.zh-Hant: 在最後晚餐時,耶穌束上手巾,倒水入盆,為門徒洗腳——主作僕人之事。

description.en: Jesus carries His cross through Jerusalem's streets toward Golgotha; Simon of Cyrene is compelled to help.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣背负十字架走过耶路撒冷街道往各各他;古利奈人西门被强迫帮祂背。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌背負十字架走過耶路撒冷街道往各各他;古利奈人西門被強迫幫祂背。

description.en: Jesus commissions the Twelve, gives them authority over unclean spirits, and sends them out two by two.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣差遣十二门徒,给他们制伏污灵的权柄,两个两个差出去。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌差遣十二門徒,給他們制伏污靈的權柄,兩個兩個差出去。

description.zh-Hant: 耶穌差遣十二門徒,給他們制伏污靈的權柄,兩個兩個差出去。

description.en: Jesus appoints seventy disciples and sends them ahead, two by two, into every town and place He was about to go.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣另派七十人,两个两个差遣他们,往自己所要到的各城各地方去。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌另派七十人,兩個兩個差遣他們,往自己所要到的各城各地方去。

description.en: The risen Christ on a Galilean mountain commands the eleven: 'Go, make disciples of all nations, baptizing them...'
description.zh-Hans: 复活的基督在加利利山上吩咐十一门徒:「你们要去,使万民作我的门徒,奉父子圣灵的名给他们施洗⋯⋯」
description.zh-Hant: 復活的基督在加利利山上吩咐十一門徒:「你們要去,使萬民作我的門徒,奉父子聖靈的名給他們施洗⋯⋯」

description.en: Jesus drives out the money-changers and dove-sellers from the Temple courts — 'My house shall be called a house of prayer'.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣赶出圣殿里的兑换银钱和卖鸽子的人——「我的殿必称为祷告的殿」。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌趕出聖殿裡的兌換銀錢和賣鴿子的人——「我的殿必稱為禱告的殿」。

description.en: The birth of Christ in Bethlehem — Mary, Joseph, the manger, and the newborn King of Kings.
description.zh-Hans: 基督降生在伯利恒——马利亚、约瑟、马槽,与新生的万王之王。
description.zh-Hant: 基督降生在伯利恆——馬利亞、約瑟、馬槽,與新生的萬王之王。

description.en: Jesus casts out the legion of demons from the man among the tombs into the herd of pigs that plunge into the sea.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣赶出坟墓中那人身上的群鬼,鬼进入猪群,猪群闯下海里。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌趕出墳墓中那人身上的群鬼,鬼進入豬群,豬群闖下海裡。

title.en: The Woman with the Issue of Blood (1)

description.en: A woman bleeding twelve years touches the hem of Jesus' garment in faith and is healed.
description.zh-Hans: 患血漏十二年的女人凭信摸着耶稣的衣裳䍁子,立即痊愈。
description.zh-Hant: 患血漏十二年的女人憑信摸著耶穌的衣裳䍁子,立即痊癒。

title.en: The Woman with the Issue of Blood (2)

description.zh-Hant: 患血漏十二年的女人憑信摸著耶穌的衣裳䍁子,立即痊癒。

description.en: With five loaves and two fish, Jesus feeds a multitude of five thousand men, plus women and children — twelve baskets are left over.
description.zh-Hans: 耶稣用五饼二鱼喂饱五千男人,还有妇女孩子——剩下的零碎装满十二篮。
description.zh-Hant: 耶穌用五餅二魚餵飽五千男人,還有婦女孩子——剩下的零碎裝滿十二籃。

description.en: A wealthy young man asks how to gain eternal life; told to sell all and follow, he turns away sorrowful.
description.zh-Hans: 一位富有的少年官来问如何得永生;主叫他变卖一切来跟从,他忧愁地走了。
description.zh-Hant: 一位富有的少年官來問如何得永生;主叫他變賣一切來跟從,他憂愁地走了。

description.en: A short tax-collector climbs a sycamore to see Jesus; Jesus calls him down by name and goes to his house — salvation comes to that home.
description.zh-Hans: 矮个税吏爬上桑树要看耶稣;耶稣叫他名字下来,到他家——救恩到了这家。
description.zh-Hant: 矮個稅吏爬上桑樹要看耶穌;耶穌叫他名字下來,到他家——救恩到了這家。

description.en: Roman soldiers strip Jesus, weave a crown of thorns, press it on His head, and mock 'Hail, King of the Jews!'
description.zh-Hans: 罗马士兵脱去耶稣衣服,编荆棘冠冕戴在祂头上,戏弄祂「犹太人的王万岁!」
description.zh-Hant: 羅馬士兵脫去耶穌衣服,編荊棘冠冕戴在祂頭上,戲弄祂「猶太人的王萬歲!」

description.en: At dawn the women find the stone rolled away; an angel proclaims 'He is not here, He is risen, just as He said.'
description.zh-Hans: 黎明时妇女发现石头已挪开;天使宣告「他不在这里,照他所说的,他已经复活了。」
description.zh-Hant: 黎明時婦女發現石頭已挪開;天使宣告「他不在這裡,照他所說的,他已經復活了。」

description.en: Thomas refuses to believe until he sees and touches the nail-marks; a week later Christ appears and invites his hand into His side.
description.zh-Hans: 多马不见钉痕、不摸钉痕就不信;一周后基督显现,邀请他探入肋旁。
description.zh-Hant: 多馬不見釘痕、不摸釘痕就不信;一週後基督顯現,邀請他探入肋旁。

description.en: Aged Elizabeth bears a son; her husband Zechariah, mute from disbelief, regains speech when he writes 'His name is John'.
description.zh-Hans: 年老的以利沙伯生子;之前因不信而哑的丈夫撒迦利亚写下「他的名字是约翰」就开口说话。
description.zh-Hant: 年老的以利沙伯生子;之前因不信而啞的丈夫撒迦利亞寫下「他的名字是約翰」就開口說話。

description.en: Ten lepers cry for mercy; all are cleansed on the way to the priests, but only one — a Samaritan — returns to give thanks.
description.zh-Hans: 十个长大麻风的求怜悯;往祭司去的路上都得洁净,只有一个撒玛利亚人回来感谢主。
description.zh-Hant: 十個長大痲瘋的求憐憫;往祭司去的路上都得潔淨,只有一個撒瑪利亞人回來感謝主。

description.en: Disciples rebuke parents bringing children; Jesus draws the little ones close — 'Of such is the kingdom of God.'
description.zh-Hans: 门徒责备带小孩来的父母;耶稣搂着小孩——「在神国的,正是这样的人」。
description.zh-Hant: 門徒責備帶小孩來的父母;耶穌摟著小孩——「在神國的,正是這樣的人」。
